verdict.rationale: SumUp's evidence only shows an MCP server and agent toolkit that let external AI clients/agents call SumUp's APIs (sumup-docs-11, sumup-docs-12, sumup-docs-25) — this is the reverse direction (SumUp as a tool for outside agents), not a built-in assistant inside SumUp's own product/dashboard that a user can delegate tasks to. No evidence of an in-app AI assistant for merchants.
